basics.label: Data Analyst
basics.summary: Data analyst with 6 years of experience turning operational data into decisions for retail and logistics teams.

work.name: ShopFront Retail
highlights: Built a SQL pipeline consolidating 14 stores of sales data into one daily model.
Shipped a Tableau dashboard used by 40 store managers every Monday.
Cut weekly reporting time from 6 hours to 1 hour by automating extracts in Python.
Mentored 2 junior analysts through their first production dashboards.

work.name: QuickFreight Logistics
highlights: Modelled delivery delays in Python and found the top 3 causes of late freight.
Maintained Excel and Power BI reports for the operations team.

publications.name: Consolidating retail sales data across 14 stores: a field report
